description:
[Servers] Build a Rust server.cfg and start command from settings. What the config builder page produces for the same choices: `server_cfg` (only settings that differ from
Rust's defaults, grouped by category, game mode and PvE first), `server_cfg_path` (where it goes), `start_args`
plus ready-made `start_sh` / `start_bat` start scripts (identity, ports and world settings - the command line
wins over server.cfg), `warnings` (`level` info/warn/danger: tags Rust drops, settings a game mode overrides,
values outside Rust's range, settings with no effect...), `changed` (every setting that differs from the
default) and `ignored` (names that aren't ConVars, credentials, bad values). Secrets are never written: the RCON
password in the start command is the placeholder `changeme`. Pure computation, nothing stored; the same build of
Rust as `/servers/config/convars`. Turn what a server owner wants ('PvE, 150 slots, 3500 map, half decay') into set=convar=value pairs (names via search_server_convars), optionally a preset, and return server_cfg + start_sh/start_bat and the warnings. Never ask for or include an RCON password: the output uses the placeholder changeme. Link https://servers.rustprofit.com/config-builder.

preset.description: Start from a preset (key from `/servers/config/presets`: `vanilla`, `pve`, `weekend`, `softcore`, `hardcore`, `primitive`, `trio`). Your `set` values apply on top.

set.description: Settings as `convar=value`, repeatable (up to 100): `set=server.hostname=My Server&set=server.maxplayers=150&set=decay.scale=0.5`. Booleans take true/false.

name: build_server_config
title: Build a Rust server.cfg and start command from settings
